questions.stem: Can the effect of a competitive inhibitor be overcome by increasing substrate concentration?

options.text: Yes, because more substrate molecules outcompete the inhibitor for the active site
Yes, but only if the enzyme is heated first
No, competitive inhibition is always permanent
No, because the inhibitor destroys the active site

questions.explanation: The effect of competitive inhibition can be reduced by increasing substrate concentration. More substrate molecules mean a higher probability that substrate rather than inhibitor will bind to the active site.
